description: This file defines an abstract class 'ChannelOwner' which manages connection channels and event subscriptions within a Playwright core client module. It includes methods for managing event listeners, creating proxy channels, handling API calls with tracing and instrumentation, and internal object lifecycle management.

classes.name: ChannelOwner
classes.description: Abstract class managing a connection channel, event subscriptions, and child channel objects within Playwright's core client.

methods.name: _setEventToSubscriptionMapping
methods.description: Sets the mapping between event names and protocol subscription names.

methods.name: _updateSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription status for a given event, calling the protocol method to enable or disable the subscription.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'on' to manage subscription updates when event listeners are added.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'addListener' to manage subscription updates when listeners are added.

methods.name: prependListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'prependListener' to manage subscription updates when listeners are prepended.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'off' to manage subscription updates when listeners are removed.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Overrides EventEmitter's 'removeListener' to manage subscription updates when listeners are removed.

methods.name: _adopt
methods.description: Adopts a child ChannelOwner, reassigning parent and updating objects map.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Cleans up object references and disposes children, marking as collected if reason is 'gc'.

methods.name: _debugScopeState
methods.description: Returns debug state including object hierarchy.

methods.name: _validatorToWireContext
methods.description: Provides validator context with channel implementation details for protocol validation.

methods.name: _createChannel
methods.description: Creates a proxy for the channel, intercepting getter to handle method validation, API call wrapping, and instrumentation.

methods.name: _wrapApiCall
methods.description: Wraps API calls with tracing, error handling, and instrumentation.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Custom serialization to prevent cluttering test output.
